spans.s:
Duḥ-śāsu is possibly a proper name in the Rigveda, and would then denote an enemy of Kuruśravaṇa. Ludwig thinks that he was a parśu or Persian, but this is most improbable, and the word may simply be an adjective meaning ‘malignant.’
Foot notes x. 33, 1.
Translation of the Rigveda, 3, 165.

Duḥ-śīma is mentioned in the Rigveda as a generous donor, his patronymic perhaps being tānva.
Foot notes x. 93, 14.
x. 93, 15.
Cf. Ludwig, Translation of the Rigveda, 3, 166.
